name: @etzhayyim/air-ffp-kotoba
description: kotoba impl of air-ffp (frequent-flyer program, Consensys c-split). kotoba-E2E split (ADR-2605181100): public tier-benefit catalog + de-identified tier-summary aggregates plaintext; enrollee PII (memberProfile) + per-member ledger (milesLedger, money as decimal strings) sealed via sdk.encryptedWrite/Read. Only the fiat merchant-of-record settlement rail (mile-purchase charge / transfer fee / IATA-BSP partner clearing) stays etzhayyim via consent-capability.
